name: QTT Tenant Product Wallet
description: The hardening review section 8 fix: a real, atomically-updated concurrency-control cache, NOT a replacement source of truth for QTT AI Credit Ledger. balance is always kept equal to SUM(QTT AI Credit Ledger.amount) for the same (tenant, product) — every credit_service.py write updates both in the same DB transaction, and a periodic reconciliation function (credit_service.reconcile_wallet) corrects any drift. The (tenant, product) unique constraint (patches/v0_5) is what makes a raw atomic UPDATE...WHERE balance>=amount race-free across concurrent requests — see credit_service.deduct_credits(). This is deliberately NOT the same design as the earlier-rejected naive 'Tenant AI Wallet' concept from the original architecture proposal, which was rejected specifically for being a mutable counter with no ledger backing at all.
